description: Turn an MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG or Opus recording into waveform art: a PNG (transparent by default) or a print-ready SVG, as bars, a filled shape or a line, in any colour and size. Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/waveform-generator (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

amplitude.description: How much of the height the loudest moment fills, 0.05 to 1. Not normalised: a quiet recording draws small.

background.description: A background colour as #rgb or #rrggbb, or null (the default) for a transparent background.

barGap.description: Bars: the gap between bars in pixels.

barWidth.description: Bars: each bar's width in pixels. Line: twice the line's thickness.

data.description: The recording's bytes, base64-encoded: an MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG (Vorbis) or Opus file. M4A/AAC and video are read only by the page at https://helpyself.com/waveform-generator/, in the browser; convert those to MP3 first. Send the whole file as it is, up to 50 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/waveform-generator (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

format.description: png for screens (transparent unless a background is given); svg for anything printed, since it scales to any size.

height.description: Image height in pixels, 40 to 8000. A PNG may have at most 8,000,000 pixels in all.

name.description: The recording's filename. The image keeps its stem: vows.mp3 becomes vows-waveform.png.

style.description: bars (separate bars, the usual waveform art), filled (one solid shape) or line (a single line along the top).

name: waveform_generator
title: Waveform Generator
